text: With respect to the elbow extensors, the long head of the triceps brachii has an optimal length-tension relationship when the shoulder is flexed to about 180° (77), meaning that this aspect of the musculature is most active during exercises in which the humerus is held overhead (e.g., overhead triceps extension).
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 8: Program Design for Maximal Hypertrophy
